players.name: Cameron Thomas
players.comment: Thomas and the Falcons agreed to a three-year extension worth up to $33 million Friday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Kendal Daniels
players.comment: Daniels (Achilles) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Divine Deablo
players.comment: Deablo (forearm) was downgraded from doubtful to out Saturday ahead of Sunday's clash against Kansas City, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: C.J. Henderson
players.comment: Henderson and the Falcons agreed to a two-year contract extension Friday.

players.name: Drake London
players.comment: London caught all five of his targets for 68 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

players.name: Jahan Dotson
players.comment: Dotson caught two passes for 16 yards on two targets in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

players.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
players.comment: Zaccheaus caught one of three targets for five yards during the Falcons' 34-17 loss to the Bengals on Sunday in Madrid. He also returned one kickoff for 28 yards and returned two punts for minus-three yards.

players.name: Michael Penix Jr.
players.comment: Penix completed 20 of 31 passes for 162 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 34-17 loss to Cincinnati. He added 50 rushing yards on three carries.

players.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
players.comment: Pitts caught three of five targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

players.name: Bijan Robinson
players.comment: Robinson carried the ball 19 times for 100 yards and a touchdown and caught six of seven targets for 47 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

players.name: George Karlaftis
players.comment: Karlaftis recorded six tackles (four solo), including 2.0 sacks, and a pass breakup in Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets.

players.name: Chris Jones
players.comment: Jones recorded four tackles (two solo), including 2.0 sacks, and a pass breakup in Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets.

players.name: Drue Tranquill
players.comment: Tranquill collected 13 tackles (seven solo) in Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets.

players.name: Nick Bolton
players.comment: Bolton recorded 12 tackles (five solo) and a forced fumble in Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets.

players.name: Mansoor Delane
players.comment: Delane (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

players.name: Harrison Butker
players.comment: Butker will remain Kansas City's kicker ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.comment: Rice secured five of seven targets for 49 yards in the Chiefs' 35-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.comment: Downs is active and slated to make his debut with the Chiefs on Sunday versus the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.comment: Worthy (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice for Kansas City.

players.name: Jaylon Moore
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Patrick Mahomes
players.comment: In addition to the Chiefs team doctors reviewing Mahomes' (throwing) elbow scans, the team sought further feedback from renowned doctors from the Kansas City Royals and Texas Rangers, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.comment: Walker (groin), who won't play Sunday in Atlanta, is expected to "be able to go" next Sunday against the Cardinals, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
